title: Specify full-width CCP2 plan indices and masks
description:
Scope: regional-plan and permitted-set encoding in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/spec/02b-ccp-receiver-aware.md. Specify ordered plans containing 1 through 255 entries, CH0 at global index zero, separate plan and operating-class identifiers, and integer-Hz lookup against an identified plan/version. Define exact MSB-first mask byte length and zero trailing padding. Independently encode boundary and sparse masks. This defines representation, not qualification or activation of the candidate 128-channel US grid.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse nonconflicting validation mechanics from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.23, but not its legacy u32 representation or sender-local rehash assumptions. Existing regional tables are not silently extended.
acceptance_criteria: Exact encodings and rejection behavior cover counts 0, 1, 8, 32, 64, 128, 255, and 256; boundary indices and wrong mask lengths/padding. Count 255 permits index 254, not 255; overflow cannot truncate into a valid count. The 128-entry set {0,64,127} encodes as 80000000000000008000000000000001. No population-count renumbering or u32/u64 truncation is allowed.
